assertions.name: in_repo_wiring_failures_are_reported_not_hidden
assertions.source: 1 producers cannot import a module that lives in this repo; top causes {'optional-dep:snappy': 7, 'other:NameError': 2, 'optional-dep:matplotlib': 1, 'other:FileNotFoundError': 1}. Each one owns at least one committed witness that cannot be regenerated, so no staleness check can ever fire on it. Reported, not fixed.

assertions.name: optional_dependency_failures_are_carved_out_separately
assertions.source: failures caused by a genuinely external optional package (['cypari', 'matplotlib', 'sage', 'scipy', 'snappy', 'spherogram']) are counted separately: 8 of them. Calling those defects would inflate the count with facts about the environment rather than about the corpus.

description: Detects committed witnesses whose PRODUCER cannot be imported, so the witness can never be refreshed and no staleness mechanism sees it. Every existing check (scriptHash drift, q0Anchor, the raw-float64 ratchet) presupposes the producer can run; when it cannot, the witness reports clean forever while its numbers age. Real instance: proton-residual-rootcause carried a convention-C z_markov = 0.49932033403356124 invisibly through the entire C->D campaign because its producer raised TypeError on every run (fixed in 179f030c2). Method: import the module by file location in a subprocess — these scripts guard work behind __main__, so an import exercises the whole top level without running the compute. Classes are reported separately because they are not the same defect: in-repo-wiring (a module that IS in this repo is not on sys.path — real and fixable), optional-dep (snappy/matplotlib etc — an environment fact, NOT a producer defect), other, and heavy-at-import (not a failure). Excludes _deprecated/. Loads by file location rather than `import <stem>` because hyphenated filenames make `import beta-decay-from-q` a syntax error in the IMPORT STATEMENT — a first pass reported 24 bogus SyntaxErrors that all parse cleanly under ast.parse, inflating 90 real findings to 109. This is a DETECTOR: it fixes nothing and does not claim every hit is a defect.
